about.title: Two businesses, one standard: reliable supply.
about.text: Pedex is a supplier of optical interconnect products and industrial flow-control equipment. Our optical division covers the full physical layer — transceivers, AOCs, fiber jumpers and fiber cables — serving telecom operators, datacenter integrators, system houses and regional distributors.
points: Optical transceivers across 10G to 1.6T, including PON and coherent platforms
AOCs and fiber cabling for in-building, campus and datacenter deployments
A separate valve division acting as authorized distributor for leading Chinese industrial valve brands
Engineering support: link budget, BOM configuration, replacement guidance
Flexible order quantities, export documentation and global logistics
about.mission: To be the supplier our customers call when a link needs to work on day one — and keep working for years after.
about.approach: We don't try to do everything. We focus on optical components we understand well, and on the valve brands we have personally vetted. If a product isn't right for your application, we'll tell you.
about.markets: Telecom & datacom · Data centers · Access networks · Industrial automation · Process industries
